forgot.title: Forgot Your Password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your customer account email. We will send a link to create a new password if the email is registered.
forgot.neutralBody: If the email is registered as an active customer account, a password reset link will be sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.

recovery.subtitle: Enter a new password for your Autentik account.
recovery.successBody: Sign in again using your new password.
recovery.successPartial: Your password was updated, but signing out all devices could not be confirmed. Sessions on other devices may still be active. Please sign in again.
recovery.invalidBody: This reset link is invalid, already used, or expired. Request a new link to continue.
recovery.passwordRejectedBody: The authentication provider rejected that password. This recovery link cannot be used again. Request a new link and use a stronger password.
recovery.unavailableBody: We could not confirm whether the password was updated. Try signing in with your new password, or request a new recovery link.
